name: SELinux Inspector
author: brunonlinespace
description: Read-only SELinux inspector with a Status dialog containing status and file-context checking, ordinary policy/context views, multi-view export, standard Options, and optional ephemeral privileged inspection through a narrow root-owned helper.

capabilities.label: Current SELinux mode
capabilities.standard: Available through ordinary SELinux interfaces when present.
capabilities.elevated: Same information; privilege does not add access.

capabilities.label: Current process context
capabilities.elevated: Same information; privilege does not add access.

capabilities.label: SELinux filesystem
capabilities.elevated: Same information; privilege does not add access.

capabilities.label: Recent AVC audit denials
capabilities.standard: Permission dependent; audit records may be restricted.
capabilities.elevated: Fixed read-only ausearch query can inspect restricted audit records when present.

capabilities.label: Policy modules
capabilities.standard: Uses semodule with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only module listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: Permissive domains
capabilities.standard: Uses semanage permissive -l with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: SELinux users
capabilities.standard: Uses semanage user -l with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: Login mappings
capabilities.standard: Uses semanage login -l with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: Port contexts
capabilities.standard: Uses semanage port -l with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.

capabilities.label: File-context rules
capabilities.standard: Uses semanage fcontext -l with the current user's access.
capabilities.elevated: Runs the same fixed read-only listing through the helper when ordinary access is restricted.
